content.title: Personal Injury Attorney, Springfield, VA | Injury Lawyers in Virginia | Becker, Kellogg & Berry, P.C.
content.text: Through combined legal experience that spans more than 10 decades, the law offices of Becker, Kellogg & Berry, P.C. offer clients comprehensive representation in diverse areas to satisfy their needs. Our law firm in Fairfax and Springfield, VA serves clients throughout Alexandria, VA and Northern Virginia, Maryland and the District of Columbia. We represent clients in a broad scope of practice areas that range from: Personal InjuryAutomobile Accidents (ex., drunk driving, trucks, pedestrians, etc.)Workers’ Compensation We can offer you a Springfield, VA firm who respects a client’s personal and legal matters and takes pride in responding quickly, scheduling appointments promptly and providing direct personal contact. Professionalism is the hallmark of our practice, and whenever possible, our attorneys employ expeditious and cost-effective approaches to resolve legal issues out of court. However, when negotiated settlements or other alternatives are not viable, our trial experience lends an edge to our firm’s courtroom litigation. Characterized by persistence and competence, we have earned a reputation of excellence among our peers and clients. Because selecting the right Northern VA Law Firm to represent your matters is an important decision, we invite you to arrange a consultation to discuss your legal concerns. We are dedicated to protecting the rights of accident victims, successfully prosecuting liable parties and recovering damages for those injured as a result of accidents or negligence of another party or business. Allow us to answer your questions and see how an attorney-client relationship with our injury attorneys may benefit you. Please contact us online or phone our office at 888-312-5087 to schedule an appointment. Lawyers Practicing in a Wide Range of Legal Disciplines Including Personal Injury, and Auto Accidents in Fairfax, Alexandria, Annandale, Springfield and Woodbridge, VA.
